A drum pattern, with each instrument's level on the LCD

description.p: Kadence is a rhythm trainer for practising musicians, built like a piece of studio gear: a backlit LCD with a swinging pendulum, rhythm level sliders and a clicking tempo dial.

ul.li: Tempo 30 to 250 BPM, set with the dial or by tapping
Beats with accents, eighths, sixteenths and triplets mixed on five sliders
30 drum patterns and three click voices
50 memories
Count-in and a reference tone for tuning

description.p: The panel is drawn by the GPU now, and the keyboard shortcuts can be seen in the app.

ul.li: The GPU puts the panel on screen (Vulkan, Metal, DX12, or OpenGL): smooth resizing, and the needle swings without anything being redrawn
New ? key under the screen (or F1, or ?): the keyboard shortcuts and the version
K shows each button's key on a badge
New keys, mostly a button's first letter: A for TUNE, P for PITCH, R for MEMORY, Esc to go back; right and left turn the dial ten clicks; Ctrl+Q quits (P alone no longer does)
START plays the first beat at once
Slider caps line up with the scale's ticks at both ends
24-bit and 8-bit sound devices are supported

description.p: A redrawn display, new lettering and packages for more Linux systems.

ul.li: New LCD with every segment, label and icon, and a 27-bar pendulum
New KADENCE / METRONOME Dr.Tick / KD-90 lettering
Pendulum swings at an even speed, drawn at the display's refresh rate; START swings out to the first beat
BEAT/PATTERN switches between beats and patterns; the dial goes on to combined bars 1+1 to 9+9
Settings stay open until another button is pressed, even while playing; labels blink at 120 BPM, values stay lit
Tuner screen shows the volume; TEMPO and TUNE flash their value twice
Instruments a pattern doesn't use show no level
New .deb, .rpm and .tar.gz packages next to the Flatpak
Loop, the Rhythm Coach and the counting voice are off until they are reworked
Metronome from 30 to 250 BPM with tap tempo and a clicking dial
Beats, combined meters, five rhythm sliders and 30 drum patterns
Rhythm Coach with Time Check through the microphone
50 memories with Loop playback, count-in and reference tone
Backlit LCD and a borderless window shaped like the case
